display_name: Zero-knob same-day early-server-block range break long, intraday flat (v1)
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1 as stamped by the Vantage terminal clock in xauusd_data.csv, the high–low range of server hours 1–8 on a calendar day is a day-local object. A long-only rule that enters only if flat when a later bar (server hour in 9..15) closes above that same-day early-block high, with fixed ATR SL/TP and force-flat at server hour 16, has no free parameters. Any edge must come from same-day early-range expansion after early-block compression under Standard STP spread costs. Hours are pure server labels — not claimed Tokyo/Asia wall-clock or London–NY overlap.

clock_contract.source: MqlRates time via Mt5ArchBridge TimeToString; fetch_data tags as UTC without conversion
clock_contract.hours_present_develop_note: develop bars show server hours 1..23 (hour 0 typically absent); early block uses 1..8

rule.entry: once per calendar day: if flat and server hour in entry_allowed_hours and early_block_high is defined for that day and close > early_block_high, enter long at that bar close
rule.early_block_high: max(high) over bars on the same calendar day with hour in early_block_hours_server; undefined until all early-block hours that exist for the day have been observed (use max of bars seen with hour in 1..8 once hour>=9 or once a bar with hour in 9..15 is reached — fixed: compute running max of highs for hours 1..8 as they print; break may fire only at hours 9..15 using the early-block high accumulated from hours 1..8 of that day (if no early bars, no trade that day)
rule.exit: SL/TP or force flat at close of bar with hour>=flat_hour same day; no overnight

null.algorithm: For each calendar day with m bars: (1) ref_0 = open[0], ref_j = close[j-1] for j>0; (2) inc_j = (open,high,low,close)/ref_j componentwise; (3) circularly rotate the m increments by k∈{0..m-1}; (4) rebuild continuous OHLC path from the original day open by chaining rotated increments so each bar unit's open/ref and true-range/ref ratios are preserved as a multiset. Timestamps and spreads remain fixed. No absolute-price day-block paste; no foreign-hour geometry on a new close.
null.notes: Canonical session null for protocol 2.2. Required because early-block high and break use within-day path geometry.
